categories.main_business_segments: Yuanjie Semiconductor Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, design, production, and sales of optical chips. Its primary products include laser chips with transmission rates of 2.5G, 10G, 25G, 50G, 100G, and higher, serving telecommunications markets (fiber access and mobile communication networks), data centers, and automotive LiDAR sectors. The company operates an IDM (Integrated Device Manufacturer) model covering chip design, wafer manufacturing, chip processing, and testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including buried heterostructure and ridge waveguide laser chip manufacturing platforms, integrated optical amplifier chip platform, high-speed modulation laser chip technology, heterogeneous compound semiconductor material epitaxial growth, small divergence angle technology, anti-reflection technology, and high-reliability integrated optical chip technology. Production involves advanced MOCVD epitaxial growth, photolithography, etching, metallization, end-face coating, automated chip testing, and high-frequency and reliability testing, enabling scalable, high-quality manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are optical module manufacturers and telecommunications operators in domestic and international markets. The main end markets include fiber optic access networks (EPON, GPON, 10G PON, 25G/50G PON), 4G/5G mobile communication networks, data centers with high-speed optical modules (100G, 200G, 400G, 800G), and automotive LiDAR applications. The company supplies major telecom operators like China Mobile, China Unicom, and China Telecom.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shaanxi Province, China, with operations primarily serving the domestic Chinese market and some international customers. It has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore for trade activities. The majority of sales and production are concentrated in China, with growing outreach to overseas optical module manufacturers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yuanjie Semiconductor operates upstream in the optical communication supply chain as an IDM, controlling the full process from chip design, wafer epitaxy, chip fabrication, packaging, to testing. It supplies optical chips to downstream optical module manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in high-speed laser chips (25G, 50G PAM4, 100G PAM4 EML, 200G PAM4 EML), high-power laser chips for silicon photonics, and integrated optical amplifier chips. It focuses on overcoming key bottlenecks such as high-frequency modulation, material reliability, and integration technologies. The strategy includes expanding into new application fields like automotive LiDAR and consumer electronics, strengthening talent development, and enhancing production capacity and technology platforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of optical chips and, to a lesser extent, packaged laser chips. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, with sales contracts specifying delivery and acceptance terms. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance, with quality dispute periods considered.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yuanjie Semiconductor is positioned as a leading domestic optical chip supplier in China, competing with international suppliers especially in high-speed and high-power laser chips. It differentiates through proprietary technologies, comprehensive IDM capabilities, and a broad product portfolio covering multiple transmission rates and applications. The company aims to break overseas technology monopolies in high-end optical chips.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 144.4 million, a 48.96% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 19.48 million, down 80.58%. The decline was mainly due to slower telecom and data center market demand and intensified price competition. R&D investment increased by 14.23% to RMB 30.95 million, accounting for 21.43% of revenue. Total assets were about RMB 2.24 billion with stable net assets around RMB 2.12 billion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yuanjie Semiconductor emphasizes its advanced proprietary technologies enabling high-speed, high-power, and high-reliability optical chips with features like small divergence angle and integrated anti-reflection, reducing downstream packaging costs and import dependence. Its IDM model ensures rapid product development and supply chain control. The company offers a diversified product portfolio tailored to various optical communication scenarios, providing competitive cost and performance advantages to customers.
